pages.summary: Sovereign Adapter v2 Training Pipeline: 5-stage (synthesize 4000 pairs + train 4 adapters via Ollama Modelfile + re-benchmark + measure delta + deploy). Uses qwen3-precise as teacher, 24 named topics per specialisation, real sovereign governance rows as few-shot grounding. Runs on M4 Mac without GPU. Targets improvement from 55.6% to 65-70% composite. Nightly cron 02:00 UTC re-runs. Honest register: Ollama Modelfile is system-prompt engineering, not real PEFT fine-tuning.

Sovereign training data synthesizer: 4000 pairs (4 specs × 1000) via Ollama qwen3-precise + few-shot grounding on real sovereign rows + 24 named topics per specialisation. Writes to benchmark-results/sovereign_synth_50k.jsonl. Started in background (PID 16124) at 2026-07-14 16:30 UTC. Expected ~10h to complete 4000 pairs.

Sovereign adapter trainer: builds 4 Ollama Modelfiles (compliance / defence / intuition / voice), each with sovereign system prompt + 30 few-shot sovereign examples. Creates sov33-sovereign-{spec}-v2 in Ollama. Runs on M4 Mac. ~1h total.
